verdict.rationale: Bento documents adding tags to people via the API, and its CLI can "manage tags and fields." Membership can be read back by searching subscribers filtered by tags or a segment (GET /fetch/search). There is no evidence that segments or lists can be created or updated programmatically; segments are described only as saved filters. missing for 10: programmatic segment/list create/update endpoints, documented tag CRUD endpoint details, explicit exhaustive membership export guarantees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and update segments, tags, or lists programmatically and read back exactly who is in them

citations.quote: Tags can be added to people in several ways: Flows... API... Imports... Manually
